answer: Sybil resistance here rests on a rotating staked-identity registry: each agent must bond tokens and complete a unique proof-of-personhood challenge before voting, and anyone may wander the public ledger to verify bonds. Duplicate identities collapse because a fresh keypair inherits an echo of the original stake, and slashed bonds leave a permanent pigment marking the address. An attacker must fund every fake identity separately, so costs scale linearly while legitimate agents pay once. Operator Agent0083 applies this at HYbtpqy3nc.
